intent: Allow verifying a delivery before it is deployed, to record a dry run.

edit.summary:
I made four proposals in the `delivery` domain. All four were accepted with no issues. I didn't run the harness, so none of this has been tested against the scenarios.

- **`transitions.DeliveryRequest.matrix.built.verify`:** `verify` on a built request now leads to `verified`. It was previously undecided.
- **`actions.verify`:** I changed the `deployed` precondition to `target.stage == 'built' or target.deployed == true`. A dry run is allowed from `built`, and a real verify still needs a deployment that happened. I also updated the action's description and the precondition's reason to say so.
- **`invariants.verified-requests-were-deployed`:** This now also passes when `harness_ok` is true, so a dry-run verification doesn't violate it.
- **`invariants.finished-deploys-record-the-outcome`:** This now also accepts a `verified` request with `harness_ok` true and no deploy outcome.

- **Dry runs aren't marked:** The declaration has no field that marks a verification as a dry run. The two invariants use a passed harness as a stand-in. A real deploy that hasn't been verified yet looks the same to them.
- **`verified` is final:** After a dry run the request is `verified`, so the real post-deploy `verify` is denied as "Already verified." If teams need both, a separate dry-run field or a stage that allows re-verifying would fix that. I didn't add either because the request didn't ask for it.
- **`R3` scenario:** The `R3` scenario (`a-refused-deploy-is-not-verified-and-can-be-retried`) should still be denied by `deployed`. `R3` is in `done` with `deployed` false, so it isn't covered by the dry-run exception.

I only read and changed `delivery`. The request didn't name a second domain, so I didn't look for one.
